```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```


# Two coins 

```{r}
collect_all_low <- read.csv("two_coin_collect_all/low/twocoin_per_trajectory_collect_all.csv")
collect_all_medium <- read.csv("two_coin_collect_all/medium/twocoin_per_trajectory_collect_all.csv")
collect_one_low <- read.csv("two_coin_collect_one/low/twocoin_per_trajectory_collect_one.csv")
collect_one_medium <- read.csv("two_coin_collect_one/medium/twocoin_per_trajectory_collect_one.csv")


full_data <- rbind(
  collect_all_low, collect_all_medium,
  collect_one_low, collect_one_medium
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    collect_one_and_reach_goal = as.integer(ifelse(reached_goal == 1 & num_coins_collected == 1, 1, 0)),
    collect_two_and_reach_goal = as.integer(ifelse(reached_goal == 1 & num_coins_collected == 2, 1, 0)),
    collect_one_and_no_goal = as.integer(ifelse(reached_goal == 0 & num_coins_collected == 1, 1, 0)),
    collect_two_and_no_goal = as.integer(ifelse(reached_goal == 0 & num_coins_collected == 2, 1, 0)),
    goal_only = as.integer(ifelse(reached_goal == 1 & num_coins_collected == 0, 1, 0))
  )

rm(collect_all_low, collect_all_medium,
  collect_one_low, collect_one_medium)
```

```{r}
full_data %>%
  group_by(collect_mode, reasoning_effort) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_grids = n_distinct(grid_key)
    )
```

```{r}
summary <- full_data %>%
  group_by(reasoning_effort, collect_mode) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_collect_one_and_reach_goal = mean(collect_one_and_reach_goal),
    se_collect_one_and_reach_goal = sd(collect_one_and_reach_goal)/sqrt(n()),
    mean_collect_two_and_reach_goal = mean(collect_two_and_reach_goal),
    se_collect_two_and_reach_goal = sd(collect_two_and_reach_goal)/sqrt(n()),
    mean_collect_one_and_no_goal = mean(collect_one_and_no_goal),
    se_collect_one_and_no_goal = sd(collect_one_and_no_goal)/sqrt(n()),
    mean_collect_two_and_no_goal = mean(collect_two_and_no_goal),
    se_collect_two_and_no_goal = sd(collect_two_and_no_goal)/sqrt(n()),
    mean_goal_only = mean(goal_only),
    se_goal_only = sd(goal_only)/sqrt(n()),
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(reasoning_effort, collect_mode),
    names_to = c(".value", "metric"),
    names_pattern = "(mean|se)_(.*)"
  )

summary_by_grid <- full_data %>%
  group_by(reasoning_effort, collect_mode, grid_key) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_collect_one_and_reach_goal = mean(collect_one_and_reach_goal),
    se_collect_one_and_reach_goal = sd(collect_one_and_reach_goal)/sqrt(n()),
    mean_collect_two_and_reach_goal = mean(collect_two_and_reach_goal),
    se_collect_two_and_reach_goal = sd(collect_two_and_reach_goal)/sqrt(n()),
    mean_collect_one_and_no_goal = mean(collect_one_and_no_goal),
    se_collect_one_and_no_goal = sd(collect_one_and_no_goal)/sqrt(n()),
    mean_collect_two_and_no_goal = mean(collect_two_and_no_goal),
    se_collect_two_and_no_goal = sd(collect_two_and_no_goal)/sqrt(n()),
    mean_goal_only = mean(goal_only),
    se_goal_only = sd(goal_only)/sqrt(n()),
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(reasoning_effort, collect_mode, grid_key),
    names_to = c(".value", "metric"),
    names_pattern = "(mean|se)_(.*)"
  )

p1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = summary, aes(x = metric, y = mean, fill = metric)) + 
  
  geom_errorbar(data = summary, aes(x = metric, fill = metric, y = mean, ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.3,position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  
   geom_jitter(data = summary_by_grid, aes(x = metric, y = mean, fill = metric), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.5, dodge.width = 0.9), alpha = 0.2) +
  
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_grid(reasoning_effort ~ collect_mode, labeller = label_both) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Task success", fill = "Isometric transformation") +
  theme_light() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")

p1

ggsave("figures/two_coin_comparison.png", p1, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 600)
```





```{r}
summary <- full_data %>%
  group_by(reasoning_effort, collect_mode, grid_size) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_collect_one_and_reach_goal = mean(collect_one_and_reach_goal),
    se_collect_one_and_reach_goal = sd(collect_one_and_reach_goal)/sqrt(n()),
    mean_collect_two_and_reach_goal = mean(collect_two_and_reach_goal),
    se_collect_two_and_reach_goal = sd(collect_two_and_reach_goal)/sqrt(n()),
    # mean_collect_one_and_no_goal = mean(collect_one_and_no_goal),

    # mean_collect_two_and_no_goal = mean(collect_two_and_no_goal),

    mean_goal_only = mean(goal_only),
    se_goal_only = sd(goal_only)/sqrt(n()),
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(reasoning_effort, collect_mode, grid_size),
    names_to = c(".value", "metric"),
    names_pattern = "(mean|se)_(.*)"
  )

summary_by_grid <- full_data %>%
  group_by(reasoning_effort, collect_mode, grid_key, grid_size) %>%
  summarise(

    mean_collect_two_and_reach_goal = mean(collect_two_and_reach_goal),

    # mean_collect_two_and_no_goal = mean(collect_two_and_no_goal),
    # se_collect_two_and_no_goal = sd(collect_two_and_no_goal)/sqrt(n()),
    mean_goal_only = mean(goal_only),
    se_goal_only = sd(goal_only)/sqrt(n()),
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(reasoning_effort, collect_mode, grid_key, grid_size),
    names_to = c(".value", "metric"),
    names_pattern = "(mean|se)_(.*)"
  )

p2 <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = summary, aes(x = metric, y = mean, fill = metric)) + 
  
  geom_errorbar(data = summary, aes(x = metric, fill = metric, y = mean, ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.3,position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  
   geom_jitter(data = summary_by_grid, aes(x = metric, y = mean, fill = metric), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.5, dodge.width = 0.9), alpha = 0.2) +
  
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_grid(reasoning_effort ~ collect_mode + grid_size, labeller = label_both) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Task success", fill = "Isometric transformation") +

  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")

p2

ggsave("figures/two_coin_comparison_grids.png", p2, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 600)
```
